requiredOutcomes: p08 re-verifies the tree: ruff format and check, typelint (>= 603 files clean), ty, scoped and full pytest (>= 1111 passed, 0 failed), uv build, ddl-check, web install, typecheck, vitest (>= 262 passed), build and strict screenshots (0 state-skipped, 0 browser errors).
No source change unless a gate fails; every such change is inside the run-3 writePaths and logged.

nonGoals: No new plans; p01-p07 and p09 not redispatched or re-implemented.
No DDL, route, permission, response key or dependency change; D1-D24 unchanged.
No C5 custom push identity change (pending-custom-push-resource-identity.md stays pending).
constraints: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md: English only, no emojis; plans under 400 lines; Python files under 1000 lines.
Strict typing (no Any, object, dict or **kwargs; dataclasses or enums; no type-ignore); typelint, ruff ANN/PGH and ty not weakened.
Raw detected values and raw item keys are never persisted, logged, indexed, notified, exported or returned; the leak matrix stays green.
Default uv run pytest passes offline; integration and live tests skip and are never listed as verification or risks.
Conventions 2, 7 and 7a; workers never run git checkout/restore/stash/reset/clean/commit/add/push.
intentionalTradeoffs: Gate-failure writePaths are the concrete v1.4 surface plus the O3 file rather than whole-tree globs, which would exceed the 512-entry fanout snapshot limit (design 17.7); anything else goes to the serial finalization as a Reconciliation request.
The live checks stay owner-only; the owner already ran them on the run-2 tree (requirements 8.1).
designDecisionsAndRationale: Design 17.7: one wave with p08 re-verify only, p01-p07 and p09 accepted, because all code is complete and owner-verified.
Design 17.7: gate-failure-only ownership includes src/telescreen/workflow/queue/sql_queue.py because run 2 stopped on that unowned file (O3).
Design 17.6 plus 17.7: the serial finalization archives all 9 plans and the 3 manifests, then reruns the gates before the single push.
supportedEdgeCases: A vitest failure under load is rerun once alone; both runs are logged; two failures are a real failure.
A gate failure outside the run-3 writePaths is a Reconciliation request, not an edit.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Live L1-L7 and PostgreSQL/Meilisearch integration runs (owner-only, skipped offline).
C5 custom push identity semantics (pending owner decision).
